description_sq:
Ne kompleksin Mangalem 21 ofrojme per shitje apartament 1+1 te pozicionuar ne katin e shtate me orientim lindje te nje godine nente kateshe.
Organizohet ne ambient ndenje se bashku me ambientin e gatimit, dhome gjumi, tualet dhe ballkon.
Prona eshte e hipotekuar dhe shitet e mobiluar.
Mund te ofrohet me cmim ekstra edhe nje post parkimi -1 me cmim extra por nuk eshte detyrim (eshte opsoinale)
Per me shume informacion na kontaktoni.
title_en: APARTMENT FOR SALE 1+1 + PARKING SPACE IN MANGALEM 21!
description_en: In the Mangalem 21 complex, we offer for sale a 1+1 apartment located on the seventh floor facing east of a nine-story building. It is organized in the living room together with the cooking area, bedroom, toilet and balcony. The property is mortgaged and sold furnished. A parking post -1 can be offered at an extra cost, but it is not mandatory (it is optional). For more information, contact us.
